Published rate for 2026 (STMA s94). Add a rule and parameter each December for the next year.

Tax evasion (false records, concealed income): 50% to 500% of the tax underpaid (art. 63), instead of the 50%-300% of art. 69.
Incorrect return without reasonable excuse or through negligence: double the tax undercharged (s95(2)).
Wilful evasion: treble the tax undercharged (s96).
5% instead of 10% when the withholding tax is paid late before any notice and not in anticipation of one (s67(2)); nil within one month with intention to pay on time (s67(3), not modelled).
Heavy additional tax of 35% in place of the 10% where facts were concealed or disguised (s68(3)).
Two times the tax on an assessment where no return was filed (s26), instead of one time under s22.

condition: target_in_jurisdiction = true and not transferor_resident = true and not indirect_transfer = true
note: Direct transfer of a Chinese company's shares by a non-resident enterprise: 10% on consideration less cost.

condition: target_in_jurisdiction = true and not transferor_resident = true and indirect_transfer = true and $cn.restructure.indirect_transfer_applies = true and not pred(indirect_transfer_purpose)
note: Indirect transfer re-characterised as direct when the arrangement lacks a reasonable commercial purpose (predicate).

condition: indirect_transfer = true and group_relation_pct >= $cn.restructure.group_safe_harbour_pct_min and property_rich_ratio <= $cn.restructure.group_safe_harbour_property_pct_max and future_cn_tax_not_reduced = true and consideration_in_shares = true
note: Intra-group reorganisation safe harbour, all three conditions of item 6: (1) 80% relation (100% when property-rich, modelled as not applying above 50%), (2) the Chinese tax on a later indirect transfer is not reduced (future_cn_tax_not_reduced, derived by the optimization layer), (3) consideration entirely in shares (consideration_in_shares).

condition: indirect_transfer = true and target_listed = true and $cn.restructure.public_market_exempt = true
note: Shares of a listed foreign company bought and sold on a public market.
A Chinese resident company's gain (on any shares) is ordinary income at 25%.

condition: target_in_jurisdiction = true and not transferor_resident = true
note: Non-resident individual: 20% on income less original value; indirect transfers by individuals are not modelled.
Resident individual: 20% on property transfer income.
Stamp tax of the transferor on the equity transfer instrument (0.05%). Rule-id suffix transferor / sold_note = seller side, transferee / bought_note = buyer side (optimization layer, acquisitions).

Stamp tax of the transferee on the same instrument (0.05%); both together 0.1%. Rule-id suffix transferor / sold_note = seller side, transferee / bought_note = buyer side (optimization layer, acquisitions).

condition: target_in_jurisdiction = true and payee_resident = true and holding_pct < $cn-hk.restructure.taxable_holding_pct_min and property_rich_ratio <= $cn-hk.restructure.property_rich_pct_min and $cn-hk.restructure.residual_residence_only = true
note: Art. 13(7): a Hong Kong resident's gain on Mainland shares is taxable only in Hong Kong unless the 25% participation (13(5)) or the property-rich clause (13(4)) applies.

condition: target_in_jurisdiction = true and payee_resident = true and target_listed = true and $cn-hk.restructure.listed_exempt = true
note: Art. 13(6): listed shares bought and sold on the same recognised exchange.

condition: target_in_jurisdiction = true and payee_resident = true and holding_pct < $cn-sg.restructure.taxable_holding_pct_min and property_rich_ratio <= $cn-sg.restructure.property_rich_pct_min and $cn-sg.restructure.residual_residence_only = true
note: Art. 13(6) unless 13(4) or 13(5) applies.
Sold note: 0.1% of consideration or value. Rule-id suffix transferor / sold_note = seller side, transferee / bought_note = buyer side (optimization layer, acquisitions).
Bought note: 0.1%; both notes 0.2% in total. Rule-id suffix transferor / sold_note = seller side, transferee / bought_note = buyer side (optimization layer, acquisitions).

condition: transferor_resident = true and not target_in_jurisdiction = true and received_in_jurisdiction = true and not substantive_business = true and $sg.restructure.foreign_asset_gains_taxable_when_received = true
note: s10L: a Singapore group entity without adequate economic substance disposing shares of a foreign company, gains received in Singapore: taxed at 17% from 2024.

condition: transferor_resident = true and holding_pct >= $sg.restructure.safe_harbour_holding_pct_min and holding_months >= $sg.restructure.safe_harbour_holding_months_min and (target_in_jurisdiction = true or substantive_business = true or not received_in_jurisdiction = true)
note: s13W safe harbour for a resident company (20% for 24 months); it does not override s10L, so the foreign-asset case without substance is excluded; s13W(1), disposals from 1 June 2012 to 31 December 2025.

condition: transferor_resident = true and holding_pct >= $sg.restructure.safe_harbour_holding_pct_min.2026 and holding_months >= $sg.restructure.safe_harbour_holding_months_min.2026 and (target_in_jurisdiction = true or substantive_business = true or not received_in_jurisdiction = true)
note: s13W(1A) safe harbour for a resident company, disposals on or after 1 January 2026 (20% for 24 months); it does not override s10L, so the foreign-asset case without substance is excluded.

condition: target_in_jurisdiction = true and not transferor_resident = true and holding_pct >= $jp.restructure.taxable_holding_pct_min and transferred_pct >= $jp.restructure.taxable_transferred_pct_min
note: Foreign corporation: taxable only under the 25% (three-year look-back) / 5% (in the year) test; then the corporate rate by filing.
A Japanese company's gain is ordinary income at 23.2% (plus local taxes, not in the library).

condition: target_in_jurisdiction = true and not transferor_resident = true and holding_pct >= $jp.restructure.taxable_holding_pct_min.individual and transferred_pct >= $jp.restructure.taxable_transferred_pct_min.individual
note: Non-resident individual: 15% on domestic-source gains from unlisted shares (STMA art. 37-12) under the 25% / 5% test of the Income Tax Act Cabinet Order art. 281(6).
Resident individual: 15% separate taxation of gains on unlisted shares (national tax; 5% local tax and 2.1% surtax not in the library).

condition: target_in_jurisdiction = true and payee_resident = true and property_rich_ratio < $hk-jp.restructure.property_rich_pct_min and $hk-jp.restructure.residual_residence_only = true
note: A Hong Kong resident's gain on Japanese shares is taxable only in Hong Kong unless the shares are property-rich (13(2)).

condition: target_in_jurisdiction = true and payee_resident = true and (holding_pct < $jp-sg.restructure.taxable_holding_pct_min or transferred_pct < $jp-sg.restructure.taxable_transferred_pct_min) and property_rich_ratio <= $jp-sg.restructure.property_rich_pct_min and $jp-sg.restructure.residual_residence_only = true
note: Art. 13(5) unless the 25% / 5% test of 13(4)(b) or the property clause of 13(4)(a) applies.

condition: target_in_jurisdiction = true and not transferor_resident = true
note: Foreign company not carrying on business in Thailand: 15% withheld on the gain under s70.
A Thai company's gain is part of net profit at 20%.

condition: target_in_jurisdiction = true and not transferor_resident = true
note: Non-resident individual: 15% withheld on s40(4) income; a resident individual's gain goes into the progressive schedule (th.restructure.resident.individual).

Transfer of share certificates: 1 baht per 1,000 baht (0.1%) of the higher of paid-up value and price, paid by the transferor (the schedule names ผู้โอน as the person liable). Rule-id suffix transferor = seller side.

condition: target_in_jurisdiction = true and payee_resident = true and property_rich_ratio <= $hk-th.restructure.property_rich_pct_min and $hk-th.restructure.residual_residence_only = true
note: A Hong Kong resident's gain on Thai shares is taxable only in Hong Kong unless property-rich (13(4)).

condition: target_in_jurisdiction = true and payee_resident = true and (target_listed = true or property_rich_ratio < $sg-th.restructure.property_rich_pct_min) and $sg-th.restructure.residual_residence_only = true
note: A Singapore resident's gain on Thai shares is taxable only in Singapore unless the shares are unlisted and three-quarters property-rich (13(2)).

condition: transferor_resident = true and not target_in_jurisdiction = true
note: A Chinese resident company transferring foreign shares credits the foreign tax on the gain against its 25% (EIT Law art. 23, ordinary credit limited to the Chinese tax on that income).

condition: transferor_resident = true and not target_in_jurisdiction = true
note: A Japanese company transferring foreign shares credits the foreign corporation tax on the gain (CTA art. 69, limited to the Japanese tax on foreign-source income).

Resident individual: the gain on shares is assessable income under s40(4)(ช) taxed with the year's other net income at the s48(1) schedule. Effective rate needs other_taxable_income and amount_payee_ccy (the gain) in THB; the s47 bis credit and expense deductions are not modelled (D-th-3).
Profit included under art. 45 is current income at the statutory rate.
Foreign income tax borne by the controlled company on the included profit is creditable within the art. 23 limit.
The foreign corporate tax of the controlled company on the included amount is deemed paid by the domestic company (SMA 66-7).
Included as miscellaneous income (SMA 40-4) and taxed by aggregation at the s89 rates.
Departure deems the securities etc. transferred at their value (ITA 60-2(1)); not applied below JPY 100 million or with five years or less of residence in the past ten (60-2(5)).
